channel.title: Read Mandarin
channel.description: Learn Mandarin Chinese with free HSK-graded short readings. Every text comes with pinyin, tap-to-translate words, audio and English translation.

item.title: 算法与偶然性 — Algorithms and Serendipity (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 205 words. 如今，音乐、视频、购物乃至新闻推送，几乎都依赖算法根据用户过往的点击与偏好进行精准推荐。 — Algorithms and Serendipity. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 失败的价值 — The Value of Failure (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 191 words. 人们常说“失败是成功之母”，似乎只要经历挫折，成功便会如期而至。 — The Value of Failure. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 记忆的重构性 — The Reconstructive Nature of Memory (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 237 words. 人们往往以为记忆就像一台摄像机，把经历原封不动地保存下来，需要时按下播放键便可重现。 — The Reconstructive Nature of Memory. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 沉没成本 — Sunk Cost (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 231 words. 经济学上所说的“沉没成本”，指那些已经付出、无论如何都无法收回的金钱、时间或精力。 — Sunk Cost. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 孤独与独处之辨 — Solitude vs. Loneliness (HSK 6)
item.description: HSK 6 · 229 words. 许多人一提到“独处”，便不自觉地将其等同于“孤独”，仿佛独自生活的人注定形单影只、郁郁寡欢。 — Solitude vs. Loneliness. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 共享经济的退潮 — The Ebb of the Sharing Economy (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 154 words. 十年前，共享单车、共享充电宝、共享雨伞几乎一夜之间出现在中国的大街小巷。 — The Ebb of the Sharing Economy. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 二十四节气 — The Twenty-Four Solar Terms (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 166 words. 二十四节气是中国古人根据太阳在天空中的位置，把一年划分成的二十四个时间段。 — The Twenty-Four Solar Terms. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 春运 — The Spring Festival Travel Rush (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 171 words. 每年春节前后，中国都会出现一场堪称世界上规模最大的人口迁移，这就是所谓的“春运”。 — The Spring Festival Travel Rush. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 方言与身份认同 — Dialects and Identity (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 173 words. 中国地域辽阔，方言种类繁多，从广东话到上海话，几乎每个地方都有自己独特的口音。 — Dialects and Identity. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 中医的现代处境 — Traditional Chinese Medicine in the Modern Era (HSK 5)
item.description: HSK 5 · 179 words. 近几十年来，随着西医在中国的普及，中医的地位经历了从被质疑到重新被重视的过程。 — Traditional Chinese Medicine in the Modern Era. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 直播带货 — Livestream Shopping (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 165 words. 打开手机，随时都能看到有人在直播间里介绍产品，一边说一边卖。 — Livestream Shopping. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 汉服复兴 — The Hanfu Revival (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 169 words. 最近几年，穿着汉服在街上散步、拍照的年轻人越来越多。 — The Hanfu Revival. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 考研热 — The Craze for Grad School Exams (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 166 words. 每年到了十二月，很多大学的图书馆都会变得座位难找，因为考研的日子快到了。 — The Craze for Grad School Exams. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 广场舞 — Plaza Dancing (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 150 words. 每天晚上，公园里都会准时响起熟悉的音乐，一群阿姨跳起了广场舞。 — Plaza Dancing. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.title: 夜市文化 — Night Market Culture (HSK 4)
item.description: HSK 4 · 155 words. 一到晚上，很多城市的老街就热闹起来，因为夜市开始了。 — Night Market Culture. Pinyin, audio and English included.

item.description: HSK 3 · 128 words. 这个周末，我去图书馆做了一次志愿者。 — My First Time as a Volunteer. Pinyin, audio and English included.
